_comment: BYOK generation pricing manifest — the HOSTED SOURCE OF TRUTH, served at ikandy.app/pricing/byok-ai-pricing.json and fetched at runtime (see PRICING_MANIFEST_URL in the IKANDY app's src/ai/cost/cost-estimator.js). The app's baked FALLBACK_MANIFEST is the dated offline fallback used only if this file is unreachable. Prices are per MILLION tokens, USD. visionPerMTok prices image/vision input (these providers bill images as input tokens, so it equals inPerMTok); perImage is for any provider that bills flat per image (none here). v2 adds per-model 'label' (dropdown display name), 'hidden' (legacy ids kept for price matching but omitted from the model dropdown), and 'recommended' (dropdown default badge) — all ignored by v1 readers. To change prices: edit THIS file and redeploy the site, no app rebuild.
_priceNotes: Verified 2026-09-03 against provider pricing pages. STANDING DATED CHECKS: (1) gpt-5.6-sol's $4/$20 is PROMOTIONAL, announced 2026-08-21 (was $5/$30) and stated as available 'at least through 2026-11-21' — on/after 2026-11-22, re-check and restore $5/$30 if it lapsed. (2) gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.8-flash run INTRO $0.75/$3.75 through 2026-12-31; on/after 2027-01-01 set BOTH to $1.50/$7.50 and drop this clause. RESOLVED 2026-09-03: claude-sonnet-5's $2/$10 launch intro is now the PERMANENT standard price — Anthropic cancelled the scheduled 2026-09-01 rise to $3/$15 (stated on the official pricing page), so do NOT bump it; the old bump-on-2026-09-01 instruction is dead. Added claude-fable-5-1 ($10/$50; claude-fable-5 is same-price and now hidden as superseded) and gemini-3.8-flash (GA 2026-09-02); the gemini recommended badge moved from gemini-3.5-flash to gemini-3.8-flash, and 3.5 Flash is hidden because at $1.50/$9 it is dominated on both price and recency. gemini-3.6-flash exists at the same $0.75/$3.75 rate but is deliberately omitted — it was never in the dropdown, so no saved setting can reference it. xAI lineup unchanged (grok-4.6/4.5 $2/$6, grok-4.3 $1.25/$2.50); the grok-4.20-* and grok-build-0.1 ids on docs.x.ai are deliberately not carried. Long-context surcharges (GPT-5.6, Gemini Pro >200K, Grok >200K) are deliberately not modeled — the estimator prices the standard tier. xAI retired grok-4/-4.1/-3 on 2026-05-15; those ids silently redirect to grok-4.3 and bill at its rate.
